slug: 降临即邪神开局绑架女武神
content_zh:
“终于是把你逮住了啊！”
林恩现在的心情可谓是舒爽到了极点。
（〃′皿）q
因为就在他的面前，那个被黑雾遮蔽的房间里面，一个满头银发，身材高挑，全身散发着耀眼光芒的的女子，此时此刻已经是被他成功地完成了究极地囚禁。
那个女人的目光冰冷，紧咬银牙，依然在不断地试图冲击周围的黑雾，想要脱困。
但是毫无疑问，没有任何的卵用。
而随着时间的推移，她的眼里也慢慢地出现了急切和气急败坏，因为所有的攻击落在那无形的黑雾之上时，都如石沉大海，激不起任何的波涛。
“有种你放我出去！和我正面一战！躲躲藏藏！只会显得你卑鄙下作！你给我出来！！”
房间内，不断地传来那清冷的叫嚣。
但林恩怎么可能进去。
“你以为你是谁？你萝吗？！”
好不容易逮住她。
要是不让她知道一下自己的厉害，她还以为自己只有三厘米呢！
而一想到这十年的经历。
林恩就咬牙切除，气不打一处来。
想他林恩这样的大好青年，十年前刚刚穿越到这个鬼地方，还没搞清楚状况，只是出去溜了个弯，直接就被这个娘们给一刀砍了啊。
要不是他能不断地在这个鬼地方重生。
他也根本没机会报仇雪恨！
而一想到自己的穿越……
林恩心里又是一阵憋屈。

他的目光落在了面前那面被他拼出的镜子上。
只见镜子当中倒映出来的，并不是和他之前一样是一个正儿八经的少年，也不是什么邋遢大叔，而是一个……
蝌蚪。
没错。
就是那种你在娘肚子里面，还没有找到自己的出路时，和几百亿个兄弟姐妹一起畅快遨游时的那种蝌蚪——这是他经过反复比对多次之后，最终所得到的结论。
“穿越也就算了，好歹有个人形啊，没有人形也就算了，好歹不要是一滩液体啊。”
林恩心平气和，但还是忍不住咬牙握拳。
不过好在。
经过了整整十年的进化，他现在也已经不是当初的蝌蚪了。
他现在已经是有鹅蛋大，前面镶嵌着一枚大眼珠子，下面还伸出了两根小触手的奇行种蝌蚪了。
而他所穿越的这个地方。
说实话，他也不太清楚。
起初他只是降临在一片粘稠而脓肿的黑雾当中，而在黑雾之外，却仿佛是一片扭曲的异常地带，有点像外太空，但是缺充斥着诸多扭曲的状物，而直到后来被那个娘们砍了几十次之后，他才从她的嘴里大概知道了他所在的到底是一个什么样的地方。
【亚空间】
但具体的信息，他了解的其实也不多。
content_en:
"I finally caught you!"
Lin En's current mood can be said to be extremely comfortable.
(〃′ plate)q
Because right in front of him, in the room covered by the black mist, was a woman with silver hair, a tall figure, and a dazzling light all over her body. At this moment, he had successfully completed the ultimate imprisonment.
The woman's eyes were cold, her teeth were clenched, and she was still trying to break into the surrounding black mist to escape.
But there is no doubt that it is of no use.
As time went by, eagerness and anger slowly appeared in her eyes, because when all the attacks landed on the invisible black mist, they were like stones sinking into the sea, unable to stir up any waves.
"If you dare, let me out! Fight me head-on! Hide and hide! It will only make you look despicable! Come out!!"
In the room, the cold shouts kept coming.
But how could Linn get in.
"Who do you think you are? Are you a loser?!"
It was hard to catch her.
If she hadn't been told how powerful she was, she would have thought she was only three centimeters!
And when I think about the experience of these ten years.
Linn gritted his teeth and cut it off, and he was very angry.
I would imagine that a good young man like Lin En had just traveled to this hellish place ten years ago. Before he could figure out the situation, he just slipped out and was cut down by this bitch.
If he hadn't been able to keep being reborn in this hellish place.
He has no chance to take revenge!
And when I think of my own time travel...
Lin En felt aggrieved again.
His eyes fell on the mirror he spelled out in front of him.
What he saw reflected in the mirror was not a serious young man like him before, nor was he a sloppy uncle, but a...
Tadpole.
That's right.
It's the kind of tadpole you are like when you are in your mother's womb and haven't found your way out yet, and you are swimming happily with tens of billions of brothers and sisters - this is the conclusion he finally reached after repeated comparisons many times.
"It's okay to travel through time. At least it has a human form. It's okay not to have a human form. It's not a puddle of liquid."
Lin En felt calm, but still couldn't help gritting his teeth and clenching his fists.
But the good thing is.
After ten years of evolution, he is no longer the tadpole he was before.
He is now the size of a goose egg, a strange-looking tadpole with a big eyeball inlaid in front and two small tentacles sticking out from below.
And this place he traveled through.
To be honest, he didn't know very well.
At first, he just descended into a thick and abscessed black mist, but outside the black mist, it seemed to be a twisted and abnormal area, a bit like outer space, but full of many twisted objects. It was not until he was chopped by that girl dozens of times that he roughly understood what kind of place he was in from her mouth.
【Subspace】
But he didn't actually know much specific information.
